hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 custom swap curve between ETH and phiEth tokens. In beforeSwap, the hook takes the input amount from the PoolManager, wraps or unwraps via the phiEth contract, and settles the output, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the AMM. Blocks direct liquidity addition and restricts pool initialization to ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee.
